snapshot.scope: Independent Planning review of bounded Library Dataset discovery and row paging.

reviewers.independence: Planning reviewed the Dataset cursor and authority boundary; Development and UI independently supplied implementation evidence.

dimensions.summary: Library discovers Datasets and appends exact current table/view pages without a new destination.
API, data and UI owners share one vault-, revision-, view- and boundary-bound cursor contract.
B6.16 browsing is bound while E6.11 citation, analytical, scale and platform proof stays planned.
Ordering, cursor tamper, checksum drift, final-page truth and stale-before-append are tested.
Existing API, data, UI, Playbook, Decision and trace owners absorb the slice.

verification.evidence: Dataset summaries and pages remain strict, bounded, pathless and read-only.

verification.command: npm run verify:decisions && npm run verify:traceability
verification.evidence: Decision and trace locks preserve planned E6.11 and its explicit open proof.

verification.command: npm run verify:boundaries && npm run verify:independent-documentation-review
verification.evidence: The exact 281-LOC discovery owner is protected and reviewed bytes are hash-bound.

coordination.compatibility: Existing Collection open, views and mutation CAS remain compatible.
coordination.acknowledgement: Planning binds read-only browsing; citation highlighting and complete E6.11 proof remain separate.

nonBlockingRisks: Analytical snapshots, joins, large-scale and signed-platform proof remain open.
Dataset summaries and cursors must never become mutation or query authority.
